title: Scottish Parliamentary regions, December 2022 (Scotland, generalised, clipped)
description: The eight regions that return the Scottish Parliament's additional member seats.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Scottish_Parliamentary_Regions_December_2022_SC_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Scottish_Parliamentary_Regions_December_2022_SC_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 8 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
